title: Update to External Distributor Rebate Program
raw_text:
Update to External Distributor Rebate Program
Category: Market Data and Connectivity; Alert 2026-022
Overview On September 1, 2026, IEX Exchange launched a new rebate program for Market Data Distributors. As described below, pending effectiveness of an SEC rule filing, IEX is expanding the program to apply to Extranet Providers who enlist new Data Subscribers in the same way the program applies to Data Subscribers. External Distributor Rebate Program As described in Trading Alert 2026-12 , IEX Exchange launched an External Distributor Rebate Program on September 1, 2026. Under the program, a Data Subscriber can earn a rebate equal to 75% of the subscription fees a new External Data Subscriber pays IEX for Real-Time IEX market data products (TOPS, DEEP, and DEEP+) it subscribes to through that Data Subscriber. IEX has expanded the External Distributor Rebate Program to also apply to Extranet Providers who enlist new Data Subscribers to subscribe to Real-Time IEX market data products. To qualify, an Extranet Provider must: opt into the program via an updated Extranet Addendum to the Connectivity Services Agreement; report to IEX each month any new Data Subscribers that began subscribing through it during the prior month; and ensure that each new Data Subscriber executes the IEX Data Subscriber Agreement. Only Data Subscribers who were not entitled to receive Real-Time IEX market data products as of July 1, 2026 count toward the rebate; it does not apply to an Extranet Provider’s existing customers. The rebate expires on the earlier of (a) the termination of the External Data Subscriber’s or Data Subscriber’s subscription or (b) August 31, 2028. Additional Resources Rule Filing: SR-IEX-2026-29 IEX Connectivity Services Agreement and Forms (including Extranet Addendum) IEX Market Data Policies More Information Please contact IEX Market Operations or IEX Market Data Team with any questions: Market Operations: marketops@iextrading.com IEX Market Data Team: marketdataops@iextrading.com About IEX Exchange Investors' Exchange LLC (IEX Exchange) is a national securities exchange designed to provide superior execution quality and set a new standard for trading. Since launching in 2016, the exchange has grown to be one of the largest exchange operators globally, by notional value traded. To learn more about IEX Exchange visit iex.io .

title: Exemption of Debt Obligations Issued by the European Union Under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for Purposes of Trading Futures Contracts on Those Securities
raw_text:
Exemption of Debt Obligations Issued by the European Union Under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for Purposes of Trading Futures Contracts on Those Securities

The Securities and Exchange Commission (the "Commission" or the "SEC") is proposing an amendment to designate debt obligations issued by the European Union as "exempted securities" for the purposes of marketing and trading futures contracts on those securities in the United States or to U.S. persons. The amendment is designed to permit futures trading on debt obligations issued by the European Union to be regulated as futures on "exempted securities," subject to the Commodity Exchange Act. The proposal is intended to increase U.S. persons' access to the market for these products, which may improve opportunities for hedging; lower transaction costs; contribute to greater market depth; reduce operational friction; and increase competition.

Listing Alert MIAX Options September 02, 2026 | 11:53 AM MIAX Exchange Group - Options Markets - Corporate Action Alert - Amphenol Corporation (APH) and Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. (ETD) Amphenol Corporation (APH) has announced a stock split and Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. (ETD) has announced a Special Cash Dividend. Associated strike price adjustments will become effective on Thursday, September 3, 2026. APH and ETD options will continue to trade without interruption on the MIAX Options, MIAX Pearl Options, MIAX Emerald Options and MIAX Sapphire Options Exchanges. All GTC orders resting on the MIAX order books in APH and ETD will be canceled at the close of business on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Additional details about the Amphenol Corporation (APH) and Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. (ETD) above corporate actions are provided in the attached OCC Memos. Please contact MIAX Listings with any questions at Listings@miaxglobal.com or (609) 897-7308. ETD Dividend 59629 APH Split 59532

NYSE Options: Professional Customer Order Review Period Update
Markets: NYSE AMERICAN OPTIONS, NYSE ARCA OPTIONS; Services: Trading, Post Trade, Market Data
NYSE Arca Options and NYSE American Options have amended their respective 'Definitions - Customer and Professional Customer' rules (NYSE Arca Rule 1, NYSE American Rule 900.2NY) to require Member Firms to review customer activity on a monthly basis, rather than quarterly, to determine whether orders that are not for the account of a Broker or Dealer should be represented as Professional Customer orders. Orders for any non-Broker/Dealer customer that had an average of more than 390 orders per day during a calendar month must be represented as Professional Customer orders for the following calendar month. Member Firms are required to make any appropriate changes to the way in which they are representing such orders within five days after the end of each calendar month. This amendment became effective July 1, 2026. Please contact rmteam@nyse.com with any questions about this update.
